items.title: 12.11 Uses of sulfur and its compounds

blocks.text: Sulfur and its compounds are used in industry and everyday life: in vulcanising rubber (12.11.1), as fertiliser (12.11.2) and in gunpowder (12.11.3), as well as in sulfuric acid (12.13) and in the organic synthesis of drugs, dyes and fragrances (12.12). Sulfur dioxide and sulfite salts are also used to preserve food.

blocks.prompt: What is the function of SO2 and sulfite salts in preserving food (Quick Check 12.5a)?
blocks.explanation: They are reducing agents and antimicrobials: they prevent oxidative browning and discolouration of dried fruit, juices and wine and inhibit the growth of bacteria, yeasts and moulds, so the food keeps longer.

items: Uses: vulcanisation, fertiliser, gunpowder, sulfuric acid, drugs, dyes, fragrances; SO2 and sulfites preserve food.
